analysis.summary: Management reported a strong financial performance for FY 2025-26, achieving a 16% revenue growth driven by strong occupancy and higher ARPOB, alongside an EBITDA margin of 29% and a PAT margin of 15%. The board approved the construction of a 300-bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises, with work expected to commence in the second quarter of 2026. Capital investments during the year included the inauguration of the Institute of Neuro Sciences & OPD Block at ₹120 Crore and advanced oncology/diagnostic investments of ₹47 Crore. The hospital also achieved significant clinical milestones across robotic surgeries, ECMO runs, and medical education programmes. Kovai Medical Center and Hospital Limited reported a strong financial performance for the fiscal year 2024-25, achieving operating income of Rs.

guidance.claim: The company reported good performance in 2025-26, posting a 16% growth in revenue compared to 12% in 2024-25.
guidance.quote: The year 2025-26 continues to exhibit good performance, having posted a 16% growth in revenue against 12% in 2024-25, driven by strong occupancy and higher ARPOB (Average Revenue Per Occupied Bed).

guidance.claim: Management stated that the OP block in Chennai will be ready for operation by the end of the year.
guidance.quote: The OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that global healthcare demand continues to rise driven by aging populations, rapid advancements in medical technology, and increasing patient expectations.
demand_outlook.quote: As global healthcare demand continues to rise—driven by aging populations, rapid advancements in medical technology, and increasing patient expectations—healthcare providers are under mounting pressure to develop cutting-edge hospitals, clinics, and medical campuses within tighter budgets and accelerated timelines.

demand_outlook.claim: There is a high demand for admission to the medical school, with all seats being filled.
demand_outlook.quote: Their reputation has become so esteemed that there is now high demand for admission to this prestigious medical school, with all seats being filled.

demand_outlook.claim: Total knee replacement, hip replacement, and partial knee replacement surgeries are increasing globally.
demand_outlook.quote: The Department of Orthopaedics and Joint replacement is highly active, with total knee replacement, hip replacement and partial knee replacement surgeries increasing globally.

capex_expansion.claim: The board approved the construction of a 300-bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises.
capex_expansion.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The new Institute of Neuro Sciences & OPD Block represents a capital investment of ₹120 Crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Representing a capital investment of ₹120 Crore, this state-of-the-art facility operates as a vertical hub of medical excellence.

capex_expansion.claim: The hospital launched Tamil Nadu's first Varian ETHOS AI-powered Adaptive Radiation Therapy system as part of a ₹47 Crore investment in advanced oncology and diagnostics.
capex_expansion.quote: We launched Tamil Nadu’s first Varian ETHOS AI-powered Adaptive Radiation Therapy system, part of a ₹47 Crore investment in advanced oncology and diagnostics and continue to lead the state in performing CAR-T cell therapies.

capex_expansion.claim: The hospital plans to add another 100 beds in the main campus.
capex_expansion.quote: We will add another 100 beds in the main campus.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition we are planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.

capex_expansion.claim: The newly inaugurated super-speciality facilities at the Sulur branch have added cath lab and MRI facilities.
capex_expansion.quote: The newly inaugurated super-speciality facilities at the Sulur branch of Kovai Medical Center now have added cath lab and MRI facilities.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to launch an upcoming neurosciences center equipped with state-of-the-art facilities.
capex_expansion.quote: The upcoming neurosciences center will be the first of its kind in this region, equipped with state-of-the-art facilities.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is focused on expanding the Department of Oncology.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also focused on expanding the Department of Oncology and addressing any existing gaps in medical care within this region.

capex_expansion.claim: Investment in equipment during the year 2023-24 amounts to 5,239.02 Lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2023-24 amounts to ` 5239.02 Lakhs.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its solar power capacity by adding a further 5 MW solar power plant.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, the company has expanded its capacity by adding a further 5 MW solar power plant.

margins_costs.claim: The hospital posted an EBITDA margin of 29% and a sustained PAT margin of 15% for the year.
margins_costs.quote: Your hospital has posted a robust EBITDA margin of 29%, which is excellent compared to the current industry standards, and has shown a sustained PAT (Profit After Tax) margin of 15%.

margins_costs.claim: The profit margin for the year was reported as 15%.
The production of biogas for captive consumption in the hospital canteen results in reduced LPG costs.
margins_costs.quote: This initiative not only effectively manages waste but also results in reduced LPG costs, contributing to both environmental sustainability and cost savings.

orders_capacity.claim: The total strength of the employees of the company as on March 31, 2026 was 6,885.
orders_capacity.quote: The total strength of the employees of the Company as on 31st March, 2026 was 6,885.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of ₹15/- per share (150%) for the Financial Year 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: Based on Company’s performance, the Board of Directors are pleased to recommend a dividend of ₹15/- per share (150%) for the Financial Year 2025-26 subject to the approval of the members.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a 100% dividend for the financial year.

management_commitments.quote: RESOLVED THAT in accordance with the provisions of Section 196,197,198 read with Schedule V and all other applicable provisions of the Companies Act,2013 and Regulation 17 (1A) of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, consent of the company be and is hereby accorded to the appointment of Dr. Nalla G Palaniswami(DIN: 00013536) as Managing Director of the Company for the period of five years with effect from 1st October, 2024
